feature_docs.soh: Current State of Health (%), derived from measured capacity / reference capacity.
feature_docs.dis_v_min: Minimum voltage during discharge (V) (~ cut-off voltage).
feature_docs.chg_duration_s: Duration of the preceding charge step (s).
feature_docs.coulombic_efficiency: discharge Ah / charge Ah of the paired steps (derived).
feature_docs.re_ohm: Electrolyte resistance Re from impedance spectroscopy (Ohm), forward-filled from the latest earlier measurement.
feature_docs.rct_ohm: Charge-transfer resistance Rct (Ohm), forward-filled from the latest earlier measurement.
feature_docs.cum_discharge_throughput_ah: Cumulative discharged Ah up to and including cycle t.
feature_docs.cum_charge_throughput_ah: Cumulative charged Ah up to and including cycle t.
feature_docs.cum_discharge_energy_wh: Cumulative discharge energy (Wh) up to cycle t.
feature_docs.soh_slope_10: Least-squares slope of SOH vs cycle over the last 10 cycles (%/cycle).
feature_docs.soh_slope_25: Least-squares slope of SOH vs cycle over the last 25 cycles (%/cycle).
feature_docs.mean_temp_last_10: Mean of dis_t_mean over the last 10 cycles.
feature_docs.mean_temp_last_25: Mean of dis_t_mean over the last 25 cycles.
feature_docs.max_temp_last_25: Max of dis_t_max over the last 25 cycles.
feature_docs.mean_current_last_10: Mean of dis_i_mean over the last 10 cycles.
feature_docs.rolling_degradation_rate_10: Trailing 10-cycle mean of the per-cycle degradation rate (%/cycle).
feature_docs.rolling_degradation_rate_25: Trailing 25-cycle mean of the per-cycle degradation rate (%/cycle).
feature_docs.rolling_degradation_rate_50: Trailing 50-cycle mean of the per-cycle degradation rate (%/cycle).

excluded_features.capacity_slope_*: Exactly proportional to soh_slope_* when the reference capacity is constant (perfect collinearity, no new information).
excluded_features.cycles_since_reference_point: Identical to cycle - first_cycle; redundant with `cycle`.
excluded_features.depth_of_discharge: All NASA cycles discharge to a fixed cut-off voltage, so DoD ~ capacity/rated ~ SOH; adds no independent information.
excluded_features.dis_t_rise: With only per-step max/min stored, temperature rise == temperature range (identical column), so only dis_t_range is kept.
excluded_features.internal_resistance (DC): Not directly measured in NASA aging files; Re/Rct from impedance spectroscopy are used instead.

validation: Leave-one-battery-out (LOBO): each battery is held out entirely and scored by models trained on the others; hyper-parameters are tuned by GroupKFold-by-battery inside each training fold; features are trailing-window only. Random row splitting is never used (temporal leakage).
model_selection_note: Best model is selected on the same LOBO scores that are reported, so those scores are mildly optimistic; see docs/methodology.md.
